blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Camera-trap imagery presents substantial variation in animal appearance, illumination, background clutter, and visual degradation. Masked autoencoders (MAEs) offer a label-free framework for modeling such data through reconstruction of randomly hidden image patches. We present WildMAE, a decoder-side extension of MAE that combines local structure-aware refinement with masked-to-visible cross-attention. A zero-gated convolutional residual path introduces a two-dimensional neighborhood prior, while gated cross-attention allows masked positions to retrieve contextual information from visible-position features without replacing the original Transformer decoder. The associated training recipe progressively introduces normalized-pixel, Sobel-edge, and perceptual objectives. In the original Snapshot Serengeti study, covering 4,744 test images at 75% masking, the reported reconstruction scores were 27.90 versus 24.33 dB PSNR, 0.840 versus 0.780 SSIM, and 0.160 versus 0.320 LPIPS for WildMAE and vanilla MAE, respectively. Additional historical records document favorable average differences under four synthetic degradation conditions and describe component variants. We present the method, experimental observations, and their scope together: the retained metrics are historical protocol-dependent results, rather than a newly reproduced, harmonized comparison or a validation of restoration from genuinely unavailable pixels. WildMAE provides a practical architectural case study for combining global token mixing with spatial and targeted contextual refinement in wildlife masked-image modeling.
blocks.zh: 相机捕捉图象在动物外观、照明、背景杂乱以及视觉退化方面有很大差异。 Masked自动编码器(MAEs)提供了一个无标签的框架,通过随机隐藏的图像补丁重建来建模这类数据. 我们介绍WildMAE,这是MAE的解码器侧展,它结合了局部结构感知的改进和蒙面对可见的交叉注意. 零格化的折叠残余路径在之前引入了二维邻接,而门化的交叉意向则允许遮蔽位置从可见位置特征中获取背景信息,而无需替换原来的变形器解码器. 相关的培训方法逐步引入了规范的像素、索贝尔尖端和感知目标。 在最初的Snapshot Serengeti研究中,覆盖了4,744个装有75%面具的测试图像,所报道的重建分数分别为27.90比24.33 dB PSNR,0.840比0.780 SSIM,以及0.160比0.320 LPIPS为WildMAE和vanilla MAE. 其他历史记录记录了在四种合成降解条件下有利的平均差异,并描述了组成部分变体。 我们把方法,实验观测及其范围一并提出:所保留的度量衡是历史协议所依赖的结果,而不是从真正无法使用的像素中重新复制、统一比较或确认恢复。 WildMAE提供了一个实用的建筑案例研究,将全球标志性混合与野生动植物遮掩图像模型的空间和有针对性的背景改进结合起来。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Camera traps make it possible to observe wildlife at scale without continuous human presence, but the resulting images vary substantially in illumination, background, object scale, occlusion, and motion. In resources such as Snapshot Serengeti [ 1 ] , even adjacent frames can depict challenging combinations of animals and cluttered natural scenes. This variability motivates image modeling approaches that can exploit visual structure without relying exclusively on species or behavior annotations. Masked image modeling is particularly appealing: a network receives a sparse set of visible patches and learns to predict those withheld during training.
blocks.zh: 相机陷阱使得在没有人类持续存在的情况下可以大规模地观测野生动物,但由此产生的图像在照明、背景、物体尺度、隔离和运动方面差异很大。 在Snapshot Serengeti[1]等资源中,即使相邻的帧也能描绘动物和杂乱无章的自然场景的具有挑战性的组合. 这种可变性激发了图像建模方法,这些方法可以利用视觉结构而不完全依赖物种或行为说明. 蒙面图像模型制作特别有吸引力:一个网络接收了一套稀少的可见补丁,并学会了预测那些在训练期间被扣留的补丁.

blocks.en: Masked autoencoders (MAEs) [ 2 ] use an asymmetric Vision Transformer (ViT) [ 3 ] encoder–decoder, processing only visible patches in the encoder and reconstructing masked targets with a lightweight decoder. The full-sequence decoder already integrates positional embeddings and global self-attention; however, its patch sequence need not explicitly prioritize local two-dimensional adjacency after token mixing. For wildlife imagery, spatial continuity and targeted access to the remaining scene may be useful when predicting silhouettes, contours, and textured regions from sparse observations. This motivates an additional decoder-side inductive bias rather than a replacement of the MAE pathway.
blocks.zh: 面具自动编码器(MAEs)[2]使用非对称视觉变形器(ViT)[3]编码器–解码器,只在编码器中处理可见的补丁,并重建带有轻量级解码器的面具目标. 全序列解码器已经整合了位置嵌入和全局自觉;然而,它的补丁序列在符号混合后不需要明确优先处理本地二维的辅音. 对于野生生物图象而言,空间连续性和有针对性地进入剩余场景,在从稀少的观测中预测淤积、轮廓和纹理区域时可能是有益的。 这促使出现额外的解码器侧导偏差,而不是取代MAE路径.

blocks.en: We study WildMAE , which retains the global MAE decoder and appends two complementary refinements (Figure 1 ). First, a zero-gated local convolutional block processes decoder patch tokens on their restored spatial grid. Second, masked-position queries attend directly to features at visible positions, followed by a separately gated feed-forward update. In the accompanying training design, pixel reconstruction is established before edge and perceptual supervision are introduced. The intent is to combine the global context of self-attention, the locality of spatial convolution, and information retrieval targeted at masked regions.
blocks.zh: 我们研究WildMAE,它保留了全球MAE解码器,并附带了两个互补的改进(图1 )。 首先,在它们恢复的空间网格上,一个零加成的局部化块处理解码器补丁符号. 第二,蒙面定位查询直接处理在可见位置的特征,然后单独加开门的向导消息更新. 在配套的训练设计中,先进行像素重建,然后再引入边缘和知觉监督. 其目的是将自觉性、空间演化地点和针对蒙蔽区域的信息检索的全球背景结合起来。

blocks.en: The original project investigated this design on a 47,349-image checked subset of Snapshot Serengeti, reporting a 75%-masking comparison, component variants, and evaluations with synthetic degradations. The present manuscript turns that study into a self-contained method and results account while retaining the original measurements and specifying the evaluation setting more precisely. In particular, it distinguishes normalized-patch prediction from RGB reconstruction that uses full-input patch statistics, an important distinction when interpreting the image-quality scores.
blocks.zh: 最初的项目调查了47,349-图像检查的Snapshot Serengeti子集,报告75%的成像比较,组件变体,以及合成降解的评价。 目前的手稿将这项研究变成一个自成一体的方法和结果核算,同时保留原始的测量并更准确地说明评价的设置。 它特别区分了普通的patch预测和使用全输入补丁统计的RGB重建,这是解释图像质量分数时的一个重要区别.

blocks.en: The contributions of this work are: • A decoder refinement architecture combining a local spatial residual branch and masked-to-visible cross-attention while preserving the original MAE decoder pathway. • An explicit description of the zero-gated refinement updates and a progressive pixel–edge–perceptual training formulation. • An organized presentation of the original wildlife-image reconstruction, component, and synthetic-degradation observations, together with clear boundaries on their interpretation and reproducibility.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的贡献是: • 解码器改进结构,结合一个局部空间残余分支和遮掩到可见的交叉注意,同时保留原有的MAE解码器路径. 明确描述零定式的改进更新和渐进式像素-尖端-概念培训的提法。 有组织地介绍原野生生物形象重建,组成部分,合成降解观测情况,同时明确解析和再生边界.

blocks.en: A decoder refinement architecture combining a local spatial residual branch and masked-to-visible cross-attention while preserving the original MAE decoder pathway.
blocks.zh: 一种解码器完善架构,结合了局部空间残余分支和遮掩至可见的交叉意向,同时保留了原有的MAE解码器路径.

blocks.zh: 明确描述零加固更新和渐进式像素-尖端-概念训练配方.

blocks.en: An organized presentation of the original wildlife-image reconstruction, component, and synthetic-degradation observations, together with clear boundaries on their interpretation and reproducibility.

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Snapshot Serengeti provides a large, annotated collection of camera-trap photographs [ 1 ] . Related work has addressed animal identification, counting, and description [ 4 ] , as well as filtering empty frames [ 5 ] . Such recognition pipelines and masked reconstruction address different questions: reconstructing withheld image regions is an image-modeling task, not direct evidence of improved ecological recognition or a substitute for observations of real animals.
blocks.zh: Serengeti快照提供了大批附加说明的摄影图集 [1]. 相关工作涉及动物识别,计数,描述[4],以及过滤空框[5]. 这种识别管道和蒙面重建解决了不同的问题:重建被屏蔽的图像区域是一项图像建模任务,不是改善生态识别的直接证据,也不是对真实动物的观测的替代.

blocks.en: ViTs model image patches as tokens [ 3 ] , and MAE reconstructs randomly masked patches from visible context [ 2 ] . CrossMAE studies patch dependence using masked queries and visible features for efficient decoding [ 6 ] . WildMAE differs in retaining the MAE full-token self-attention decoder and adding a separate masked-query refinement afterward; consequently, its design should not be interpreted as inheriting CrossMAE’s computational-efficiency claims. MCMAE [ 7 ] combines convolution and masked autoencoding, underscoring that local processing is not itself a novel ingredient. The distinction here is the placement of a local spatial branch after global decoder processing, followed by visible-to-masked feature retrieval. HAP [ 8 ] introduces human-part-based structure priors; WildMAE instead uses a generic patch-grid prior without part labels.
blocks.zh: ViTs模型图像补丁作为符号[3],MAE从可见上下文中随机重建蒙面补丁[2]. 交叉 MAE利用蒙蔽的查询和可见的特性研究补丁依赖性,以高效解码[6]. WildMAE在保留MAE全托式自留式解码器和在之后添加一个单独的遮盖式整流器方面有所不同;因此,其设计不应解释为继承了CrossMAE的计算效率要求。 MCMAE [7] 结合了演化和蒙面自动编码,强调本地加工本身并不是一个新成分. 这里的区别是在全球解码器处理后放置一个局部空间分支,然后是可见到质量的特征检索. HAP [8] 介绍以人为主体的结构前身; WildMAE则使用没有部分标签的通用补丁网格前置.

blocks.en: Pixel reconstruction measures target fidelity, whereas Sobel gradients emphasize local image boundaries. SSIM [ 9 ] and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) [ 10 ] characterize complementary aspects of visual agreement. Progressive supervision in WildMAE changes the terms of the reconstruction objective; it is distinct from learning a masking curriculum as in CL-MAE [ 11 ] . Because LPIPS is also a training component in the final stage, LPIPS evaluation is best interpreted alongside, rather than instead of, pixel and structural measurements.
blocks.zh: 像素重建测量以忠诚为目标,而索贝尔梯度则强调局部图像边界. SSIM [9]和所学知觉图像补丁相似性(LPIPS)[10]是视觉协议的互补方面特征. WildMAE的渐进监督改变了重建目标的条件;它不同于学习CL-MAE[11]中的遮掩课程。 由于LPIPS也是最终阶段的培训组成部分,LPIPS评价最好与像素和结构测量并列解释,而不是与之并列解释.

blocks.zh: 3 拟议方法

blocks.en: 3.1  Overview and MAE backbone
blocks.zh: 3.1 概况和千年生态系统评估骨干

blocks.en: Let I ∈ ℝ 224 × 224 × 3 I\in\mathbb{R}^{224\times 224\times 3} be an RGB image. Patch size 16 × 16 16\times 16 yields N = 14 × 14 = 196 N=14\times 14=196 patches of dimension D = 16 2 ⋅ 3 = 768 D=16^{2}\cdot 3=768 . For a masking ratio r = 0.75 r=0.75 , the index sets of visible patches 𝒱 \mathcal{V} and masked patches ℳ \mathcal{M} have sizes 49 and 147. The retained ViT-B encoder contains 12 blocks with width 768 and 12 attention heads. It processes visible tokens, after which learned mask tokens and positional embeddings restore a full-sequence decoder input. The decoder provides a global context representation that the proposed refinements further process.

blocks.en: 4  Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1  Dataset, preprocessing, and training
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 数据集、预处理和培训

blocks.en: The study planned a 50,000-image subset of Snapshot Serengeti Season 1 and retained 47,349 checked image IDs, comprising 37,903 training, 4,702 validation, and 4,744 test records. Input images are center-cropped to a square and resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 for evaluation; pretraining additionally uses random resized crops and horizontal flips. The checked subset includes animal and empty-frame images. Training and the primary reconstruction study use a fixed 75% random patch-masking ratio.
blocks.zh: 研究规划了Snapshot Serengeti第1季的5万图像子集,并保留了47 349个已检查图像ID,包括37 903个培训、4 702个验证和4 744个测试记录。 输入图像被中-缩到一个方形上,并调整到224×224/224\times 224用于评价;预训额外使用随机调整大小的作物和水平翻转. 选中的子集包括动物和空框图像 。 培训和初级重建研究采用固定的75%的随机补丁按摩比例。

blocks.en: The reported optimizer is AdamW with weight decay 0.05. The first stage specifies base learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , 40 warm-up epochs, and effective batch size 64 (batch 8 with eight-step accumulation); the saved implementation scales this base learning rate by effective batch size over 256. Later stages specify nominal learning rates 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} and 10 − 5 10^{-5} with two warm-up epochs, batch size four, and 16-step accumulation. This account describes the original recorded training recipe, not a fresh rerun. The original report identifies an NVIDIA RTX 5090 as the training hardware.
blocks.zh: 报告的优化者是重量衰减0.05的AdamW. 第一阶段具体规定了基础学习率 10 - 3 10 - 3 - 3 10 - 3 }, 40 个热化时代,以及有效的批量尺寸 64(第8批,分八步积累);所节省的执行量按256个以上的有效批量大小衡量这一基础学习率。 后期规定名义学习率2×10−5 2\times 10×5 和 10×5 10×5 5 ),有两个温暖的时代,批量规模4,以及16步的积累. 这个说法描述了原始录制的训练食谱,而不是新鲜的重播. 原始报告确定NVIDIA RTX 5090为训练硬件.

blocks.en: 4.2  Model variants and evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 4.2 示范变体和评价协议

blocks.en: The retained implementation contains a standard WildMAE constructor with decoder width 512 and depth 8, as well as a V4Strong constructor with width 768 and depth 16. The corresponding retained vanilla MAE constructor has width 512 and depth 8. All use the same ViT-B encoder family. Their existence documents implemented variants; the surviving materials do not establish a complete checkpoint-to-row mapping for the headline comparison. Consequently, Table 1 is retained as the original report’s result, not presented as a newly generated capacity-matched ablation.
blocks.zh: 保留的执行中包含一个标准的WildMAE构造器,有解码器宽度512和深度8,以及一个宽度768和深度16的V4Strong构造器. 相应的保留香草MAE构造器有宽度512和深度8. 全部使用相同的VIT-B编码器家族. 其存在文件已执行变体;幸存材料没有为标题比较建立完整的检查站对站台映射. 因此,表1作为原始报告的结果予以保留,而不是作为新生成的能力匹配指数列报。

blocks.en: The original evaluation reports PSNR (higher is better), SSIM (higher is better), and LPIPS (lower is better). To translate normalized predictions back into image-space values, the retained reconstruction code uses 𝐩 ^ i RGB = 𝐩 ^ i ​ s i 2 + ϵ + μ i , \widehat{\mathbf{p}}^{\mathrm{RGB}}_{i}=\widehat{\mathbf{p}}_{i}\sqrt{s_{i}^{2}+\epsilon}+\mu_{i}, (10) where μ i \mu_{i} and s i 2 s_{i}^{2} are measured on the full corresponding input patch. Thus the image-space scores characterize input-statistic-assisted masked reconstruction ; they are not a test of RGB recovery when hidden-patch statistics are genuinely unavailable. The preserved baseline and WildMAE evaluator implementations also differ in aggregation and composite-image construction. We therefore distinguish historical reported numbers from results that would require a newly harmonized common evaluator.

blocks.en: 4.3  Scope of available records
blocks.zh: 4.3 现有记录的范围

blocks.en: The present manuscript uses the original course report, surviving source code, manifests, and retained evaluation summaries. Existing saved robustness CSVs permit arithmetic re-aggregation, but image files and model checkpoints were not present in the research package used for manuscript preparation. No new training or checkpoint-based inference was conducted for this manuscript. In particular, there are no newly calculated multi-seed confidence intervals or downstream wildlife-recognition results.
blocks.zh: 本手稿使用原始课程报告,幸存源代码,清单,并保留评价摘要. 现有保存的坚固性CSV允许算术重新汇总,但用于编写手稿的研究包中没有图像文件和模型检查点。 没有对这份手稿进行新的培训或基于检查站的推断。 特别是,没有新计算的多种子信任间隔或下游野生动物识别结果。

blocks.en: 5  Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1  Overall reconstruction observations
blocks.zh: 5.1 国家 总体重建观察

blocks.en: Table 1 reproduces the primary comparison from the original report on the 4,744-image test split at nominal 75% masking. Its recorded arithmetic differences are + 3.57 +3.57 dB PSNR, + 0.060 +0.060 SSIM, and − 0.160 -0.160 LPIPS for WildMAE relative to vanilla MAE. The reported values are consistent in direction across pixel, structural, and perceptual metrics, and provide the principal historical observation motivating the proposed refinement design. Because the original checkpoint identities and common evaluator configuration cannot now be established, these differences are descriptive rather than an independently validated controlled estimate of the added modules’ effect.
blocks.zh: 表1转载了原始报告中关于4,744-图像测试的初级比较,在名义上为75%的遮盖。 其记录的算术差异为+3.57+3.57 dB PSNR,+0.060+0.060 SSIM,和−0.160-0.160 WildMAE相对于香草MAE的LPIPS. 所报告的数值在像素、结构、和感知度量之间方向一致,提供了推动拟议改进设计的主要历史观察。 由于现在无法确定最初的检查站身份和共同的评估者配置,这些差异是描述性的,而不是对新增模块效果的独立验证的控制估计。

blocks.en: Table 1: Original reported reconstruction results at nominal 75% masking on 4,744 test images. Historical course-report values; not newly reproduced under a common evaluator.
blocks.zh: 表1:4,744个测试图像的原始报告重建结果名义上为75%。 历史课程-报告价值;不是在共同评价下新转载的。

blocks.en: 5.2  Component variants
blocks.zh: 5.2 构成部分变式

blocks.en: Table 2 preserves the original project’s component comparison. The single local-refinement and cross-attention variants each show favorable reported scores relative to the original baseline row. Under the basic pixel loss, the dual-refinement row remains above baseline but does not consistently improve over both individual variants. The strongest reported row combines the dual-refinement model with the staged objective. This pattern motivates examining complementary structure, context, and supervision, but should not be taken as a capacity-matched causal decomposition: complete initialization, model-size, and evaluator provenance for these historical rows is not retained.
blocks.zh: 表2保留了原项目组成部分的比较。 单一的局部精炼和交叉注意的变体相对于原来的基准线,都显示比较有利的报告分数。 在基本像素损失下,双精度列仍然高于基线,但并没有在两种变体上持续改善. 报告最强的一行结合了双精度模型和阶段目标. 这种模式促使人们审查互补的结构、背景和监督,但不应被视为一种与能力相称的因果分解:这些历史行的完整初始化、模型大小和评价者出处没有保留。

blocks.en: Table 2: Component-variant results as reported in the original project at 75% masking. The rows are descriptive historical records, not a newly verified matched-control series.
blocks.zh: 表2:原始项目中报告的75%的变异成分结果。 该行是描述性的历史记录,不是新核实的匹配控制系列.

blocks.en: 5.3  Synthetic-degradation observations
blocks.zh: 5.3 合成-降解观测

blocks.en: The original project also evaluated clean inputs and four synthetic perturbations—Gaussian noise, low light, motion blur, and random occlusion—under 75% masking. Table 3 reproduces rounded mean differences from the retained robustness records; their arithmetic aggregation was independently checked during manuscript preparation. The recorded means favor WildMAE in each condition, with the smallest PSNR separation under low light. These are differences of saved evaluation means , not fully controlled paired-corruption estimates. Only 2,372 of 4,744 image records per condition share matching mask hashes across the two model outputs, and identical corrupted inputs cannot be established from the retained files.
blocks.zh: 最初的项目还评估了干净的投入和4个合成扰动——古西语噪音、低光、运动模糊和随机隔离——低于75%的遮掩。 表3转载了与保留稳健性记录的四舍五入平均值差异;在编写手稿时,对其算术汇总进行了独立检查。 记录的表示每个条件都偏向WildMAE,低光下最小的PSNR分离. 这些是所节省的评价手段的差别,并非完全控制配对腐败估计数。 每个条件的4,744个图像记录中只有2,372个共享了两个模型输出的匹配的遮罩散列,并且无法从保留文件中建立相同的腐败输入.

blocks.en: Table 3: Descriptive differences in retained degradation records at nominal 75% masking. Δ \Delta PSNR and Δ \Delta SSIM are WildMAE minus baseline; LPIPS reduction is baseline minus WildMAE. The original report rounded these quantities to three decimal places.
blocks.zh: 表3:名义上75%的降解记录中保留降解记录的描述性差异。 \Delta PSNR和\Delta SSIM是 WildMAE 减去基线;LPIPS 的减少是 基线 减去 WildMAE。 最初的报告将这些数量四舍五入到小数点后三位。

blocks.en: The clean row of Table 3 is not interchangeable with Table 1 : the robustness pipeline computes its masked-region structural and perceptual scores differently from the primary reconstruction scripts. Separate historical experiments with other model versions, masking ratios, or loss schedules are therefore not substituted into the primary comparison.
blocks.zh: 表3的干净行与表1是无法互换的:稳健性管道计算其蒙蔽区域结构和感知分数与主重建脚本不同. 因此,与其他模型版本、遮盖比率或损失时间表分开的历史试验不能替代初级比较。

blocks.en: 6  Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 讨论和限制

blocks.en: WildMAE’s methodological contribution is the combination of a preserved global Transformer decoding pathway with an explicitly local residual branch and a directed masked-query refinement. Zero-initialized gates allow the added branches to enter optimization gradually. The original results provide encouraging, complementary pixel- and perceptual-metric observations under the studied reconstruction setting, while the component table illustrates the relevance of studying the architecture and supervision jointly. These observations do not establish improved downstream encoder representations or a new state of the art.
blocks.zh: WildMAE在方法上的贡献是将保存下来的全球变形器解码路径与明确的局部残余分支和直接的遮盖式整流器结合起来。 零初始化的门使新增的分支逐渐进入优化. 原始结果在研究的重建环境下提供了令人鼓舞的、互补的像素和感知测量观测,而组成部分表则说明了联合研究建筑和监督的相关性。 这些意见没有确立改进的下游编码器表示或新的最新技术。

blocks.en: The retained RGB reconstruction converts normalized predictions using full-input patch statistics, including those of masked patches. Accordingly, the reported image-quality scores describe statistic-assisted reconstruction, not recovery of fully unavailable image content. Moreover, the available baseline and WildMAE evaluators differ in metric aggregation and masking/composite conventions, while some model variants have different decoder capacities. The archived degradation means are not based on fully matched masks and corruption realizations. Finally, 2,590 of the 4,744 test records share capture-sequence identifiers with training records and all test records share location identifiers; the original image-level split is not a held-out-site assessment. These limitations qualify the strength and generality of the historical comparisons without changing the measurements originally reported.
blocks.zh: 保留的RGB重建会利用全输入补丁统计,包括遮盖补丁的统计,转换正常的预测. 因此,所报告的图像质量分数描述的是统计协助的重建,而不是完全没有图像内容的恢复。 此外,现有基准和野生海洋生态评估评价人员在计量汇总和遮盖/复合公约方面有所不同,而一些模型变体则具有不同的解码能力。 存档的退化手段并非基于完全匹配的面具和腐败意识。 最后,4,744个测试记录中有2,590个共享带有训练记录的捕捉序列识别符,所有测试记录共享位置识别符;原始图像层分拆不是被搁置的场外评估. 这些限制限制了历史比较的强度和普遍性,而没有改变最初报告的测量。

blocks.en: A focused next step would use a shared evaluator and deterministic image-indexed masks, compare capacity-matched decoders, and test recovery without hidden-patch statistics. Sequence-disjoint evaluation would further clarify generalization to independent camera-trap capture events. Such studies, as well as repeated-seed stability tests, computational cost measurements, and downstream classification or detection, remain future work rather than implied results of this manuscript.
blocks.zh: 一个重点突出的下一步将使用一个共用评价员和确定性图像索引口罩,比较能力匹配的解码器,并测试恢复情况,而不进行隐藏标记统计。 序列 -- -- 脱节评估将进一步澄清对独立摄像捕获事件的概括。 这种研究,以及重复种子稳定性测试、计算成本测量和下游分类或检测,仍然是今后的工作,而不是这一手稿的默示结果。

blocks.en: 7  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented WildMAE, a structure-aware masked-autoencoding design that preserves global MAE decoding while adding zero-gated local refinement, masked-to-visible cross-attention, and progressive pixel–edge–perceptual supervision. The original Snapshot Serengeti report and retained experiment records describe favorable reconstruction-metric observations under heavy masking and several synthetic degradations. By specifying the implementation and evaluation scope, this manuscript provides a clear account of the proposed approach and a basis for further controlled validation. Future work should assess the method using a harmonized, leakage-free RGB recovery protocol and stronger generalization splits before extending its claims to real-world wildlife-image restoration.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了WildMAE,一种结构意识蒙面自动编码设计,它保留了全球MAE的解码,同时增加了零加分的局部精细化,蒙面到可见的交叉意向,以及进步的像素-对接-概念监督. 原始的Snapshot Serengeti报告和保留下来的实验记录描述了重蒙和若干合成降解下有利于重建的观测. 通过具体说明实施和评价范围,这份手稿为拟议办法提供了清楚的说明,并为进一步控制性验证提供了依据。 今后的工作应当使用统一、无渗漏的RGB恢复协议和更有力的泛化分解来评估该方法,然后将其主张扩大到现实世界的野生生物图像恢复。

blocks.en: Research provenance and availability
blocks.zh: 研究来源和可用性

blocks.en: This manuscript develops a four-author final project for CIE6032, Deep Learning Foundations and its Applications , at The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen. It retains original reported measurements and adds manuscript-level clarification and static review of surviving materials; no new training or checkpoint-based inference was performed. A public repository of original project materials is available at https://github.com/Keke946/WildMAE-Wildlife-Image-Reconstruction ; that repository does not supply the original image files or model checkpoints. Any code reuse must respect its third-party notices and applicable source licenses.
blocks.zh: 本手稿为深圳香港中文大学CIE6032,深大学习基金会及其应用开发了四作者最终项目. 它保留了最初报告的测量数据,并增加了手稿层面的澄清和对幸存材料的静态审查;没有进行新的培训或基于检查站的推断。 在https://github.com/Keke946/WildMAE-Wildlife-Image-Reconstruction上,有一个原始项目材料的公共存放处;该存放处不提供原始图像文件或示范检查站。 任何代码再利用都必须尊重其第三方通知和适用的源许可证。
